old_caption: The video showcases a static scene on a wooden floor where a large number of colorful dominoes are arranged in circular patterns. The dominoes are stacked in vibrant hues including red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, and pink. At the center of the arrangement stands a black domino placed vertically on a yellow stand. A black domino with a yellow stripe is positioned horizontally across the center, aligned with the vertical black domino on the yellow stand. The dominoes begin to fall in a chain reaction, cascading outward in a mesmerizing display of colors and movement. The sequence captures the dominoes' descent, highlighting their bright colors against the neutral backdrop of the wooden floor. The video concludes with the dominoes scattered across the floor, creating a visually striking pattern of falling pieces.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a dynamic scene on a wooden floor where a large number of colorful dominoes are arranged in a circular pattern. The dominoes are stacked in vibrant hues including red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, and pink. At the center of the circle stands a black domino placed vertically on a yellow stand. As the video progresses, a hand enters the frame from the top left corner, holding a black domino with a yellow stripe. This domino is carefully positioned at the center of the circle, aligning it with the vertical black domino on the yellow stand. Upon release, the dominoes begin to fall in a chain reaction, cascading outward in a mesmerizing display of colors and movement. The sequence captures the dominoes' descent, highlighting their bright colors against the neutral backdrop of the wooden floor. The video concludes with the dominoes scattered across the floor, creating a visually striking pattern of falling pieces.
caption: The video showcases an elaborate layout of multicolored dominoes on a light wood floor, forming loops and arcs around a black slanted ramp on a yellow pedestal. The lower and central loops, plus the row of dominoes laid flat on the ramp, stay still throughout. Within the upper arc, white-topped dominoes tip over one after another, each rotating flat inside its own loop while neighboring pieces stand. The first visible toppling occurs in a small loop at the upper right, after which the falling motion travels leftward from loop to loop. A green loop's marker then rotates flat, followed by a blue, a yellow, and a purple loop, each change confined to a single upright piece. The white-topped domino of the leftmost green loop starts to tip while the cascade is still in progress. The camera holds a fixed overhead view, so the only motion is this steady right-to-left progression of individual dominoes. No hand or other trigger is visible, and the fate of the remaining standing pieces lies beyond the captured frames.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.

and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
